story.title: India Releases First Funds Under Rs 1 Lakh Crore RDI Scheme, Backing Five Deep Tech Startups
story.summary: The Indian government has disbursed the first cheques under its Rs 1 lakh crore Research, Development and Innovation Fund, selecting five deep tech startups working across space, robotics, batteries, drones, and advanced healthcare. This marks a significant milestone in India's push to translate state capital into frontier technology development. The RDI Scheme is one of the largest government-backed innovation funding mechanisms in India's history.
